# Beta Agonists


*This covers the inhaled β-agonists used for bronchodilation. Information on catecholamines and sympathomimetics with activity on β-receptors is covered under [adrenergic vasoactives](../cvs/adrenergic_drugs.qmd).*

## Common Features

|Pharmacodynamic Effects|β-agonists|
|--|--|
|**Resp**|Bronchodilatation, ↓ HPV causing ↑ shunt and potential ↓ PaO~2~ if O~2~ is not co-administered.|
|**CVS**|↑ HR (β~1~ with higher doses), ↓ BP (β~2~ with lower doses) |
|**GU**|Tocolytic.|
|**Metabolic**|Hypokalaemia from β~2~ stimulation of Na^+^/K^+^ ATPase, hyperglycaemia.|
|**Other**|Potentiates non-depolarising muscle relaxants|
